claim_one_line: THE FRAME TRIBUNAL (P-136; a compiled verdict on the record of 2026-10-14, attacked by both seats -- the SM seat's W82 and section 101, chat1's selection report): no frame on record is shown to satisfy the principle's demands on its own -- F1 (Lambda's fibre at one tau) holds CP and the chiral three given Lambda but its hierarchy needs free numbers and its D1 needs a vacuum no dynamics selects (the only selected vacua, omega and the cusp, have none); F2 (the surface) holds the moves but needs an outside source for the three, forbids CP violation and has no hypercharge; F3 (the audit lane's E8) holds the moves only by a supplied completion that, on its flat background, loses the weak roots and Y in every pairwise-commuting class, and its index is not computed (the lane's scope note, taken before landing); F5 (chat1's thread frame) fixes tau's role and the normalisation within a vacuum but its vacuum is weighed, not selected, at c = 6, and it cannot choose a CP sign; F4 (main's candidate, the Standard Model in E6) is refuted by the record (27 (x) (2 + 1) gives one 27, W22, W23, B1440, sm:B1270) and fails D4 on E6's down-lepton tie (W55, W56). Lemma A holds with both halves (the holonomy's V4 and the moves' S3; commutants 2, 3, 1 recomputed on main): wherever the moves act as parallel symmetries, the generations' charges are alike. The D1 criterion, ruled by the owner ('agreed', P-147): a vacuum-broken symmetry counts if the vacuum is selected by a run dynamics, and a chosen background completion is a D6 'supplied' entry. Verdict: outcome 2; the parent is a seven-clause specification, labelled a conjecture (P-108): the moves with a selected vacuum and a completion over the rank-six bundle that keeps the weak roots and Y (in the lane's frame a dichotomy, W83: Y survives only if the family index is not the weave's three); the three without a tagged unit; a family-blind anomaly-free hypercharge; the condensate and the flavon in one theory with typed fields reconciled and the electroweak vertex; a CP source that is not mirror-symmetric; a derived normalisation; and the down quarks split from the charged leptons -- with the selection principle (FK9) over every 'which'. No Standard-Model value is derivable until the parent is built and its vacuum selected. [Audited by main (P-152, B1655, 2026-10-15): no frame is SHOWN to satisfy every demand: D3, D4 and D8 are open, untested or failing in every column, so outcome 2 could not have come out otherwise; F1/D5 is graded FAIL where the demand is 'a hierarchy possible'; F2's 'forbids CP violation' rests on W74 alone, and its hypercharge is UNTESTED in the table] 0 of 19.
